evidence.detail: left April 8; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 11 (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 13 and July 25, carried from the melt-out dates at Sawmill (10,200 ft) and Bishop Pass (11,200 ft) to the pass elevation.
